subject: EdgeCare inference cost-to-feature deep-dive & pilot pricing path
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
To: Sara Park <sara.park@edgecare.ai>, EdgeCare Sales <sales@edgecare.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: EdgeCare inference cost-to-feature deep-dive & pilot pricing path

Hi Sara — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side.

Summary of the call (two-minute digest):
- Use case: triage + visit summarization + clinician decision support in mobile app.
- Expected traffic: pilot users -> live in Q3; engineering expects bursty UX with many short sessions.
- Requirements called out: latency ~ <400ms token streaming, PII controls, SOC2 evidence.

Key asks from you:
- Confirm 1) expected monthly token volumes for pilot and Year‑1 scale, and 2) initial monthly budget range you have for hosted inference.

Preliminary unit-econ framing (attached projection): edgecare_token_projection_v1.xlsx
- We provided three workload buckets in the sheet (low / mid / high). Example assumptions we used:
  - Tokens per session (avg): triage 600, summarization 900, support 300
  - Pilot volume (baseline): 30M tokens/month; Year‑1 scale: 200–300M tokens/month
- Inference cost assumptions (internal): ~ $400 / 1M tokens on typical medium-quality hosted configs (this is Redwood internal cost proxy)
- Pricing levers to meet margin & payback: list price bands at $1,200 / $1M -> $2,200 / $1M depending on SLA, dedicated capacity, and KV cache effectiveness

Unit-econ asks for your answers so we can lock a pilot price:
1) Target $/1M tokens you can accept for a 90-day pilot (range if possible).
2) Whether you can commit to a minimum-burn (tokens/month) for pilot pricing.
3) Priority features (we'll map $/feature): triage, summarization, DS assist — tell us which must be in pilot.

Proposed next steps:
- You send confirmed token/budget ranges and feature priority (this week)
- We send a 90-day pilot pricing band and a short mutual action plan (MAP) + SOC2 evidence checklist
- Align on procurement point-of-contact and simple SOW if pilot approved

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: edgecare_token_projection_v1.xlsx]
From: Sara Park <sara.park@edgecare.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
Cc: EdgeCare Sales <sales@edgecare.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EdgeCare inference cost-to-feature deep-dive & pilot pricing path

Vivek — thanks for the clear summary and the workbook. A few clarifications from our product/ops side below.

Our current thinking (estimates; will confirm with finance):
- Pilot (Q3): ~30M tokens/month (targeting 3k daily active users, light summarization).
- Ramp (3–12 months): scale to ~250M tokens/month if metrics look good.
- Budget: pilot bucket $8k–$12k/mo; scale budget looks like $60k–$100k/mo on commercial terms.

Feature priorities for pilot (must-haves):
1) Triage (short prompts, ~300–700 tokens/session)
2) Summarization (longer, ~800–1,200 tokens/session)
3) Clinician decision support (lower volume but higher SLA)

On price sensitivity:
- For pilot, we need a simple predictable band to justify a PO (prefer fixed monthly rather than pure per-token if possible).
- For Year‑1 scale, flexible per-token tiers with volume discounts make sense.

Compliance & procurement notes:
- SOC2 + encryption at rest required before production; procurement will want a quick evidence bundle.
- Our standard vendor onboarding takes 2–3 weeks once we have the SOC2 artifacts.

I'll confirm the numbers with finance tomorrow and loop in procurement contact if those ranges hold.

—Sara
Sara Park
Head of Product, EdgeCare
[sara.park@edgecare.ai]
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
To: Sara Park <sara.park@edgecare.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EdgeCare inference cost-to-feature deep-dive & pilot pricing path

Sara — appreciate the quick clarity. Based on the ranges you gave, I sketched a short unit-econ and payback view below to make trade-offs explicit. See attached pilot_pricing_band_v2.pdf for simplified bands.

Assumptions (pilot):
- Pilot burn: 30M tokens/month
- Internal Redwood inference cost proxy: $400 / 1M tokens (this is our backend cost estimate pre-discounts and caching)
- Operational overhead + SLA (avg): add $150 / 1M tokens
- Effective marginal cost to Redwood for hosted pilot: ~$550 / 1M tokens

Suggested pilot pricing (simple bands):
- Band A (basic hosted): $1,250 / 1M tokens -> gross margin ~56% vs marginal cost
- Band B (SLA + faster routing): $1,750 / 1M tokens -> margin ~69%
- Fixed monthly alternative: $10,500/mo for up to 30M tokens (simple for procurement)

Per-feature rough $/month mapping (example at 30M tokens split):
- Triage (45% of tokens) -> ~13.5M tokens ~ Band A cost to customer $16.9k/mo of list-equivalent; incremental dev cost negligible
- Summarization (40%) -> ~12M tokens ~ list-equivalent $15k/mo
- Decision support (15%) -> ~4.5M tokens ~ list-equivalent $5.6k/mo

CAC/payback quick sketch (assume Redwood net revenue = list price minus platform discounts):
- If we sign pilot at $10,500/mo (fixed) and average deal acquisition cost (sales + SE + legal) = $31k, CAC payback is ~3 months after ramp.
- If we price at Band A ($1,250 / 1M) with no upfront commit, CAC payback lengthens to ~5–6 months at same CAC assumptions because initial month revenue is lower.

Trade-offs and ask:
- If EdgeCare can commit to a 90-day minimum volume (30M/mo) we can offer the fixed band at $10.5k/mo and accelerate onboarding (and include a SOC2 evidence bundle).
- If no min commit, recommend Band A per-token to keep flexibility.

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) Sara confirms whether procurement can issue a 90-day PO at fixed $10.5k/mo (or counter proposal).
2) We circulate the pilot MAP + SOC2 evidence bundle within 48 hours.
3) Ben to own procurement checklist / PO intake; Karthik to run expected perf profile and suggest caching knobs for summarization to lower marginal cost.

[Attachment: pilot_pricing_band_v2.pdf]

Best,
Vivek
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: EdgeCare inference cost-to-feature deep-dive & pilot pricing path

Vivek / team — solid framing. Quick internal notes:
- I can take the PO/procurement thread once Sara confirms the $10.5k fixed pilot ask. I'll prepare a short SOW and a 90-day MAP template.
- Karthik, please prioritize a short runbook for caching advice (summarization + prefix caching) — should cut effective cost by ~15–25% in practice.
- Marissa, can you validate the margin math vs our streak pricing and signoff a temporary pilot discount policy?

I'll wait for Sara's confirmation and then open a procurement ticket. Also, flagging SOC2 evidence pack to DX team — we should be ready to hand over the required artifacts in 48 hours if they commit.

—Ben
Senior Customer Success | Redwood Inference
